verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a first-party export of analytics metrics from the dashboard as CSV or XLSX files, which is an open-format export of part of a user's data. The pack never documents exporting the core data (index records, settings, rules, synonyms) or a full-account export for migrating away. The Search API and CLI only mention managing indices and records, not exporting them. missing for 10: documented export of index records/settings/rules/synonyms, full-account bulk export, migration-off/exit guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of data portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To export any of the metrics from the Algolia dashboard, click Download. You can export and download your analytics data as CSV or XLSX files.
You can export and download your analytics data as CSV or XLSX files.
